jd:
Software Engineering Intern, Product & Developer Productivity - HP IQ 
 Description - 
 HP IQ's Product Integrity & Developer Productivity team is responsible for building next-generation tools and systems that improve developer productivity and product quality at scale. We are specifically investing in agentic systems that automate complex workflows, from intelligent JIRA triage and root-cause analysis to test planning and quality automation. In this internship role, you will work directly with our hiring manager and team to design, build, and deploy agents that utilize pre-trained machine learning models to solve real problems for developers and quality engineers. This is an exceptional opportunity to be part of a team navigating the fundamental shift toward agentic development and to contribute meaningfully to tools that thousands of developers will rely on. 

 What You Might Do 
 As an intern on our team, you'll contribute to real-world engineering projects that explore how AI can improve the way software is built, tested, and maintained. Depending on business priorities and your team's needs, you may have the opportunity to: 
 
• Design, build, and iterate on AI-powered tools and workflows that improve engineering productivity. 
• Develop intelligent systems that help automate software development, testing, debugging, or quality assurance processes. 
• Prototype and evaluate new approaches for applying large language models (LLMs) and agentic AI to solve complex engineering challenges. 
• Collaborate with software engineers, machine learning engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners to deliver impactful solutions. 
• Participate in technical design discussions, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving sessions. 
• Analyze technical challenges, propose innovative solutions, and contribute fresh ideas that improve products, tools, and engineering workflows. 
• Build, test, and iterate on production-quality software while learning modern engineering best practices. 
• Present your work, share technical learnings, and contribute to a collaborative engineering culture. Essential Qualifications  
 
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor's or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
• Solid understanding of coding fundamentals and comfort with at least one programming language; you should be able to learn new languages and frameworks as needed. 
• Familiarity with agentic systems, AI tools (such as Claude Code or OpenAI), or model utilization in applications; deep machine learning expertise is not required as we focus on using pre-trained models, not building them. 
• Ability to break down complex problems into manageable steps and solve them independently while knowing when to ask for help. 
• Willingness to question established processes and propose alternative approaches; comfort in an environment that values fresh thinking and continuous improvement. 
• Strong communication skills; ability to explain your reasoning clearly and articulate the logic behind your technical choices. 
• Familiarity with software development workflows, quality assurance, testing practices, or developer tooling (helpful but not required). Preferred Skills 
 
• Experience building or working with automation tools or systems that improve workflow efficiency. 
• Exposure to or familiarity with JIRA, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) systems, or testing frameworks. 
• Experience working in cross-functional teams or in environments where you collaborated with people from different technical backgrounds. 
• Understanding or coursework in machine learning, AI, or agent systems. 
• Example projects demonstrating agentic thinking, such as personal projects using AI tools to automate tasks. 
 Hourly Pay Range: $40.00–$50.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience. 
 2027 Internship Program Dates: May/June–August/September 2027. Final dates will be based on student schedules.

 The salary range for this role is listed above. Final salary offered is based upon multiple factors including individual job-related qualifications, education, experience, knowledge and skills.

role: Software Engineering Intern, AIML Platform - HP IQ
jd:
Software Engineering Intern, AIML Platform - HP IQ 
 Description - 
 HP IQ's AI Machine Learning (AML) team is building the foundational platform powering a new generation of agentic devices. This platform orchestrates the complete lifecycle of AI models: from creation and fine-tuning through optimized inference and intelligent orchestration. The team works to make complex AI capabilities run efficiently on-device, enabling locally-deployed agentic experiences that reduce token costs and improve privacy. In this internship role, you will contribute to one or more core pillars of the AML platform: model inference optimization, orchestration and agent workflows, or model creation and fine-tuning. You will partner closely with experienced engineers to ship features that directly impact HP's next-generation devices and gain visibility into how each component of an end-to-end AI system integrates and scales.
 What You Might Do 
 
• Work on model hosting and inference optimization, learning how to profile, benchmark, and accelerate model execution on resource-constrained devices; experiment with quantization, distillation, or other optimization techniques to reduce latency and memory footprint. 
• Contribute to orchestration frameworks and agent workflows, building or extending systems that coordinate multiple models and agents using tools like LangGraph or LangChain; develop an understanding of when agentic patterns are appropriate and how to design robust, scalable orchestrations. 
• Participate in model customization and fine-tuning, taking pre-trained language models and adapting them for specific use cases; conduct experiments, evaluate results, and iterate on model configurations to improve performance for target tasks. 
• Collaborate cross-functionally with system software, design, and product teams to understand how your work integrates into the broader platform; communicate progress, challenges, and technical decisions clearly and seek mentorship from engineers with deep expertise in your focus area. 
• Contribute to open-source projects or internal libraries relevant to inference, orchestration, or model training; demonstrate ownership of end-to-end outcomes and ownership of improving the platform's capabilities and reliability. Essential Qualifications  
 
• Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Some coursework or project experience in machine learning, systems engineering, or software development is expected. 
• Demonstrated technical communication skills: ability to articulate project goals, outcomes, challenges, and technical decisions clearly; comfort explaining technical concepts to peers and mentors. 
• Genuine familiarity with one or more of the following: model inference and optimization, orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain), model fine-tuning and adaptation, or similar systems-level AI work. Project experience, open-source contributions, or course projects demonstrating depth in at least one area are highly valued. 
• Collaboration and ownership mindset: comfort working in cross-functional teams, asking for help when needed, and taking responsibility for outcomes; ability to operate with some ambiguity and seek clarity proactively. 
• Problems-solving orientation: ability to debug issues, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and make reasonable decisions when multiple approaches are viable. Preferred Skills 
 
• Open-source contributions to inference engines (e.g., vLLM), model repositories, or orchestration libraries; demonstrated ability to contribute meaningfully to a shared codebase. 
• Experience with Python and ML-adjacent libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, FastAPI, or similar). 
• Familiarity with on-device or edge AI constraints and optimization techniques. 
• Experience with system-level profiling and performance optimization. Hourly Pay Range: $40.00–$50.00 per hour. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, qualifications, and experience.

About Commonwealth Fusion Systems: 
 
Commonwealth Fusion Systems is on a mission to deliver the urgent transition to fusion energy.
 
Combining decades of research, top talent, and new technologies, we’re designing and building commercially viable fusion power plants. And we're working with policymakers, suppliers, and many others to build the energy industry of the future.
 
We’re in the best position to make it happen. Since 2018, we’ve raised $4 billion of capital, making us the largest and leading fusion company in the world.
 
Now we’re looking for more thinkers, doers, builders, and makers to join us. People who’ll bring new perspectives, solve tough problems, and thrive as part of a team. 
 
If that’s you and this role fits, we want to hear from you.


Join the power movement as a Software Engineering Intern
 
We are looking for a talented Software Engineering Intern to join our team! CFS interns are highly valued within the organization and placed into meaningful and challenging roles.


Program Details::
• 13-18 week internship 

• 40-50 hours per week with set hourly salary based on year in school 

• Opportunities on site in Devens, MA. If an intern is going to be on site, you will be responsible for your own transportation and housing 

• Specific project assignments and required technical skillset will vary based on the team’s existing need. 

• Opportunities available for currently enrolled college students in all levels of schooling from bachelor’s degree to PhD 

• Interns must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer

What you'll do::
• Develop simulation models and model infrastructure for both real-time and off-line (high fidelity) simulations 

• Develop control software across multiple platforms, including real-time Linux, microcontrollers, FPGAs, or PLCs 

• Full-stack software development for internal data storage & analysis tools  

• Develop operator interfaces, workflows, and data analysis tools

What we’re looking for::
• Pursuing an engineering degree with focus in the field of Computer Science 

• Familiar with programming languages such as C++, Python, and Golang 

• Experience with control or real time software  

• Hands-on experience through academic research, project teams, machine shops, hackathons, or industry internships  

• Demonstration of exceptional results through a range of different pursuits 

• High self-motivation and drive to execute quickly with excellent troubleshooting/problem-solving skills Strong communication skills and a willingness to learn

Must-have Requirements::
• Willingness to travel or work required nights/weekends/on-call occasionally 

• Perform activities such as typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time 

• Dedication to safety to mitigate industrial hazards that may include heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, lead (Pb), high voltage, and cryogenics

#LI-Onsite


At CFS, we excel in fast-paced environments, driven by our values of integrity, execution, impact, and self-critique. As we grow, we’re eager to bring on mission-driven folks who offer diverse perspectives and fresh ways to tackle challenges.
 
We value diversity deeply and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer by choice. We consider all qualified applicants equally, regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law.
 
This role requires compliance with U.S. laws concerning the export of controlled or protected technologies or information (collectively, “Export Control Laws"). Any offer of employment will be contingent on the need for compliance with such Export Control Laws.

Introduction to the Job   
 ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in San Diego and San Jose, California, Chandler, Arizona, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.    
 This position will be part of the Capability Center within ASML Business Services (ABS) US Capability Center (US CC) with a primary focus on US business administration projects. The Business Systems AI Intern will explore how AI can be applied to US CC processes by identifying use cases, developing agentic workflow concepts, and recommending practical solutions that support business objectives.   
 Role and Responsibilities   
 
• Identify and map high-value, repetitive workflows that are candidates for agentic automation based on employee-submitted use case suggestions.   
• Help establish AI as a team capability by designing and recommending agentic workflow approaches, skills libraries, tools, and processes that support consistent adoption across the organization.   
• Collaborate across US CC functions and regions to ensure that deliverables are consistent with US CC’s AI ecosystem and strategy, document the approach, and recommend scalable standards and best practices for future projects.   
• Engage stakeholders to identify knowledge gaps and pain points for AI adoption as a team capability.   Education and Experience   
 
• Currently pursuing a degree in business, information systems, computer science, or data science.   
• Experience with agentic AI ecosystems/processes, project management concepts, and enterprise business systems. Examples of experience include prior internships, projects, or personal portfolio work.   
• Experience working in a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team environment.   
• Fluent in English (spoken and written).   
• Experience creating AI guidance and governance documents preferred.   Skills   
 
• Ability to document and communicate complex concepts to audiences without expertise in the subject.   
• Ability to develop and apply agentic AI in the context of business administration projects.   
• Strategic thinking to contextualize internship scope in a broader sector roadmap.   
• Comfortable working in a multi-cultural environment; values diverse perspectives.   
• Organized and able to prioritize tasks effectively to manage multiple responsibilities.   
• High sense of responsibility, accountability, and commitment to quality.   
• Proficient in Copilot Studio or similar AI platform.   
• Proficient in Microsoft Office tools including Teams, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.   Success Measures   
 
• Deliverable: propose at least one agentic workflow that automates a defined, high-value team process and simulate the workflow with Copilot chat.   
• Time savings: demonstrate a reduction in time spent on repetitive or rote tasks.   
• Quality: achieve equal or better quality output compared to current manual processes, as qualitatively evaluated by process stakeholders.   
• Standardization: reduced reliance on individual ad hoc AI use and documented framework that can be applied to future use cases.   Other Information   
 
• This position is located on-site in San Diego, California, requiring regular in-person attendance for work-related events, training sessions, and meetings.   
• Physical requirements include sitting, walking, talking, hearing, using hands and fingers to keyboard, handle, and feel; occasional stooping, kneeling, crouching, twisting, reaching, and stretching; and occasionally lifting/moving up to 20 pounds.   
• Specific vision abilities required: close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.   
• ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE AA M/F/Veteran/Disability).   For more information about applying for a job at ASML, please refer to our frequently asked questions.   
 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.
 
 Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .

The JM Family College Internship Program is designed to create an opportunity for college students to have meaningful work experiences that tie to their programs of study. As part of this program, you will actively contribute to your team’s success, learn about JM Family’s companies and culture while obtaining new skills through learning opportunities, networking events and much more.
  
 The ideal candidate will be available to work full-time during the Summer Internship Program ( May 24th, 2027 - July 30th, 2027 ).
  
 Interns will engage in meaningful work and gain insights into specific projects or tasks, providing hands-on experience, and contributing to various department initiatives. They will learn about JM Family’s culture including our core values: Consideration, Cooperation, Communication, Innovation and Accountability. These core values are part of our keys to success and the skills that embody these values are what drive our success as an organization.
  
 As an AI & Decision Science Intern on SET’s AI & Advanced Analytics team, you will work alongside experienced data scientists to apply statistics, machine learning, and advanced analytics to real business challenges, including demand forecasting, optimization, and logistics planning. You will own a scoped project with mentorship, gain hands-on experience with how models move from prototype to production, and present your findings to the team and business stakeholders. Your contributions will help develop and deploy machine learning models and AI solutions that address key business opportunities across areas such as fixed operations, marketing, fleet, sales planning, distribution, and inventory.
  
 Responsibilities: 
 
• Evaluate business opportunities and underlying data to identify potential advanced analytics use cases, assess value propositions, and recommend appropriate technical approaches. 
• Extract, clean, explore, and analyze complex datasets using SQL, Python, statistical analysis, and data mining techniques to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies. 
• Design, develop, test, and refine statistical and machine learning models for business challenges such as demand forecasting, optimization, and logistics planning. 
• Support model development and deployment using the Microsoft technology stack, including Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and Azure Synapse Analytics. 
• Evaluate model performance using appropriate metrics and validation methods, including holdout testing and cross-validation, while documenting results and limitations. 
• Collaborate with data scientists, business partners, and IT to understand business needs, translate them into analytical solutions, and support the development of AI tools for end-user consumption. 
• Write clean, reproducible code, maintain clear technical documentation, and communicate project progress and final findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.  
 Qualifications: 
 
• This is a full-time position with flexible working arrangements depending on the business need. 
• The ideal candidate will be actively enrolled in a bachelor’s, master’s, or other degree-seeking program at an accredited college or university, with a focus in a relevant field. Candidates in related fields will also be considered. Must have completed at least one semester of coursework. 
• Relevant fields of study include Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
• Working knowledge of Python, including common data libraries such as Pandas and NumPy, and SQL skills including joins, aggregations, and filtering. 
• Understanding of statistical analysis, predictive and prescriptive analytics, and core machine learning concepts such as regression, classification, overfitting, train/test splits, and model evaluation. Hands-on experience with a machine learning framework such as Scikit-learn is preferred. 
• Preferred experience or exposure includes AI, time-series forecasting, optimization, experimental design, Git/GitHub, Microsoft Azure or Fabric, data visualization tools, and LLM-based tools such as RAG or AI coding assistants. 
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to learn new tools quickly and clearly explain technical concepts and analytical findings to non-technical audiences. 
 This job description may not be inclusive of all assigned duties, responsibilities, or aspects of the job described, and may be amended at any time at the sole discretion of JM Family. All work arrangements are subject to associate performance, business need and manager discretion, and may be revised as necessary.
